scope: Context-aware declarations observed in the Palot Electron source and computed-style capture after excluding selectors, values, custom properties, and non-property tokens.

summary.policy: Prioritize properties implicated by admissible source/native A/B evidence, but keep every observed unknown in the compatibility backlog until implemented, explicitly excluded, or proven render-neutral.

unknownProperties.risk: Intrinsic sizing and scroll virtualization can diverge when fallback content extents are discarded.
Superellipse geometry affects dialogs, popovers, cards, sidebars, and pill-shaped controls.
Glyph selection and advances affect line breaks, baselines, and visual text parity.
Scrollbar chrome and contrast differ from the source.
Reserved scrollbar clearance and usable content width can diverge.
Spinner and progress-ring arcs lose their source geometry and motion treatment.
Text raster and shaping intent is not represented in the native text path.

catalogOmissions.requiredDisposition: Normalize the legacy alias to the existing overflow-wrap implementation and test both spellings through capture, IR, materialization, and screenshot output.
